The spec says "Battery, which can be charged through M5Stack" and "optional power switch". The switch is for disconnecting battery from the bus to power off. If the body diode conducts during charging, the battery will charge even when switch off. That might be intended (charging always possible). But if the switch is off, the battery is disconnected from the M5Stack bus for discharge, but charging can still occur through body diode. That's a common arrangement. Not an anomaly.
